# A boundary html renders from code rather than markup: under a reactive `if`,
# inside a slot a component inserts there, and in the body of a component
# built at run time. Each reached codegen as an *ir.ErrorBoundary among the
# flat statements of a render function and panicked irwalk, which has no arm
# for one. A raise finds its handler through the call, so by then the boundary
# is its children; each case here raises on mount and the handler records it.


env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'
grep '<span>inside slot</span>' app.sngl.snapshots/slot.html
grep '<span>a card</span>' app.sngl.snapshots/instance.html

# A boundary with a fallback in an instance body, under a vbox: the fallback
# is a reactive `if` inside the boundary, so the vbox is its parent. The node
# got no id for that -- only a reactive child directly under it did -- and
# the render was called with no parent at all; its first render also sat
# inside the boundary, where the factory did not look for one to anchor. The
# card whose mount raises shows its fallback, ahead of what follows it, though
# its content rendered nothing to insert the fallback before.
sngl test --platform=html failed.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
grep 'end a</span>.*failed b bad</span>.*end b</span>' failed.sngl.snapshots/failed.html

# A boundary that is itself the root of a render slot, rather than under a
# node inside one: directly under a reactive `if`, directly under a reactive
# `for`, and nested in a boundary that has a fallback, whose content becomes
# the reactive `if` passBoundaryFailed writes. Each rendered nothing.
sngl test --platform=html direct.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
grep 'display:contents"><span>direct</span></span>' direct.sngl.snapshots/direct.html
grep '<span>row a</span><span>row b</span>' direct.sngl.snapshots/direct.html
grep '<span>o1</span><span>content</span><span>o2</span>' direct.sngl.snapshots/direct.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { none { html } }

component Panel(content ...component node) node {
    vbox {
        content
    }
}

component underIf node {
    var show = true
    var caught = ""

    vbox {
        if show {
            vbox {
                boundary(@error(e) { caught = e.message }) {
                    text(value="inside if")
                    effect(@mount { error.raise("if", "") })
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

component inSlot node {
    var show = true
    var caught = ""

    vbox {
        if show {
            Panel {
                boundary(@error(e) { caught = e.message }) {
                    text(value="inside slot")
                    effect(@mount { error.raise("slot", "") })
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

component Card(label string) node {
    var caught = ""

    vbox {
        boundary(@error(e) { caught = e.message }) {
            text(value="{label} {caught}")
            effect(@mount { error.raise("card", "") })
        }
    }
}

component inInstance node {
    var items = ["a"]

    vbox {
        for var it = items {
            Card(label=it)
        }
    }
}

func testUnderIf(t Test, c underIf) {
    t.assert(c.caught == "if")
}

func testInSlot(t Test, c inSlot) {
    t.assert(c.caught == "slot")
    t.snapshot("slot")
}

func testInInstance(t Test, c inInstance) {
    t.snapshot("instance")
}

window {
    underIf
    inSlot
    inInstance
}
-- failed.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { none { html } }

component Field(label string) node {
    var msg = ""

    vbox {
        boundary(@error(e) { msg = e.message }) {
            component failed {
                text(value="failed {label} {msg}")
            }

            effect(@mount {
                if label == "b" {
                    error.raise("bad", "")
                }
            })
        }
        text(value="end {label}")
    }
}

component main node {
    var items = ["a", "b"]

    vbox {
        for var it = items {
            Field(label=it)
        }
    }
}

func testFailed(t Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("failed")
}

window {
    main
}
-- direct.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { none { html } }

component main node {
    var show = true
    var items = ["a", "b"]
    var caught = ""
    var outer = ""

    vbox {
        text(value="start")
        if show {
            boundary(@error(e) { caught = e.message }) {
                text(value="direct")
            }
        }
        text(value="end")
        for var it = items {
            boundary(@error(e) { caught = e.message }) {
                text(value="row {it}")
            }
        }
        boundary(@error(e) { outer = e.message }) {
            component failed {
                text(value="failed {outer}")
            }

            text(value="o1")
            boundary(@error(e) { caught = e.message }) {
                text(value="content")
            }
            text(value="o2")
        }
    }
}

func testDirect(t Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("direct")
}

window {
    main
}
